name: raggin
description: This project focuses on the development of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system, which enhances the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating information retrieval from external data sources.

ollama.serverURL.description: The URL of the Ollama server.

ollama.giveContext.description: Add the context to the Prompt

ollama.modelName.description: The name of the model to use.

ollama.prompt.default:
Given the {codeblock} below, generate a concise, insightful comment that explains its purpose and functionality within the script. Ensure the comment uses the appropriate comment syntax for the {language} language. If applicable, mention any inputs or outputs expected in the code block. The comment should:
- Be concise (maximum 2 lines).
- Provide clarity about the code's purpose and functionality.
- Focus solely on the provided block, without assumptions about the rest of the code.
- Return only the comment, formatted correctly for the {language} language, and nothing else.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
